title.en: How Would You Build a World from Paper?
title.zh: 只用一张纸，你会怎样造一个世界？

description.en: Six imaginary construction choices explore folded routes, cutout characters and layered scenery. Discover what your paper world gives visitors to do.
description.zh: 六次想象造纸景，探索折叠路径、剪影角色与分层景物，看你的纸世界邀请访客做什么。

introduction.en: Build in imagination; no tools, sharp objects or crafting skill are required. This game follows creative choices rather than measuring spatial reasoning, manual ability or artistic worth.
introduction.zh: 只需想象，不用工具、尖锐物或手艺。本游戏跟创作选择走，不测空间推理、动手能力或艺术价值。

focus.en: Creating a paper world around traversable routes, characters with small actions or layers that change the view.
focus.zh: 围绕可走的路径、有小动作的角色或改变视野的层次，造纸世界。

label.en: A folded path linking two parts of the sheet.
A simple character with one thing to do.
label.zh: 一个有事可做的简单角色。

label.en: Two layers that reveal different views when moved.
label.zh: 移动就显不同景的两层。

prompt.en: A visitor enters your imagined world. They can…

label.en: Choose a little action for a paper character.
Look behind a foreground shape to find another scene.
Follow the route and choose where to turn.

prompt.en: One feature does not work as imagined. You…

label.en: Simplify the foreground so the second layer can be seen.
label.zh: 简化前景，让第二层看得到。

label.en: Shorten the route so its two ends really connect.
label.zh: 缩短路，让两端确实相接。

label.en: Give the character a smaller action the world can support.
label.zh: 给角色世界能承接的小动作。

prompt.en: You add one surprising detail. It is…

label.en: A path that crosses the edge and returns elsewhere.
label.zh: 越过纸边再回别处的路。

label.en: A background figure who briefly changes the main action.
label.zh: 短暂改变主要动作的背景角色。

label.en: A distant shape that changes meaning when brought forward.

prompt.en: Your paper world needs a pause. You create…
prompt.zh: 纸世界需一个停点，你造……

label.en: A place where the character can stop its little task.
label.zh: 角色可停下小任务的一处。

label.en: An open platform between two turns of the route.
label.zh: 路径两次转弯间的小平台。

label.en: A clear view where the layers can rest without movement.
label.zh: 各层不用动也可看的清景。

prompt.en: What would you most enjoy showing someone?

label.en: How the same pieces make a different view together.
label.zh: 同样纸片相叠，景怎样变。

label.en: How the little route takes them across the sheet.
label.zh: 小路怎样带人走过纸页。

label.en: What the paper character can choose to do next.
label.zh: 纸角色接下来能选做什么。

summary.en: Your paper world invites a visitor to travel through a small structure. Turns and connections matter because they let the sheet be experienced as a route rather than only an image.
summary.zh: 你的纸世界邀人经过小结构。转弯与相连，让纸页成一段路，不只一张图。

example.en: An imagined folded strip might lead from a paper doorway to a little platform, then return along a different edge of the sheet.
example.zh: 想象折条从纸门到小平台，再沿纸的另一边返回。

strength.en: A connected route gives the visitor something concrete to try and helps separate a world’s usable path from its decorative background.
strength.zh: 相连路径给访客具体可试之事，也区分可走之路与装饰背景。

tradeoff.en: An intricate route can overshadow the places along it. A shorter path with one interesting stopping point may offer more than many clever turns.
tradeoff.zh: 复杂路会抢沿途景。一条短路加有趣停点，可能比许多巧转更好玩。

experiment.en: Draw a route across a sheet with one entrance, one stopping point and one return. Trace it with a finger before adding more destinations.
experiment.zh: 在纸画入口、停点与返回路。先用手指走过，再添目的地。

summary.en: Your world begins when a paper character has something small to do. The action gives the scenery a reason to matter without requiring an elaborate plot or a heroic quest.
summary.zh: 你的世界从纸角色有件小事可做开始。动作让景有作用，不需复杂情节或英雄任务。

example.en: A paper figure might carry an imaginary button across a table-sized town and choose whether to deliver it or make it a sign.
example.zh: 纸人可把想象纽扣带过桌面城镇，选送出去或改成牌子。

strength.en: A simple character action can give a visitor an immediate way into the world and show which parts of the setting are relevant.
strength.zh: 简单角色动作给访客入口，也显出场景哪些部分有关。

tradeoff.en: A character does not need a complete biography to move a little scene. Too much explanation may crowd out the action you wanted to show.
tradeoff.zh: 角色动一小幕不需全传记。解释过多，反会挤掉想展示的动作。

experiment.en: Invent a paper character with one object and two possible uses for it. Describe the different small scene each choice would create.
experiment.zh: 编纸角色、一物与两种用途，描述各选会造什么不同小景。

summary.en: Your world changes when its parts overlap differently. A foreground edge and a distant shape can make a new relationship without adding more pieces to the sheet.
summary.zh: 你的世界因纸片重叠不同而变。前缘与远形能造新关系，不必再添片。

example.en: An imagined paper arch might frame a tiny hill in one position and a character’s doorway when the front layer shifts.
example.zh: 纸拱一处框住小山，前层一移又成角色门口。

strength.en: Layered views let a small set of elements support several scenes and make the act of looking part of the world’s play.
strength.zh: 分层视野让少量元素支持多景，也让观看动作成为玩法。

tradeoff.en: A reveal can be hard to follow when every layer moves at once. Keeping one part steady gives the viewer an easier reference point.
tradeoff.zh: 各层齐动时难跟显露。留一部分不动，观者更容易找参照。

experiment.en: Draw a foreground frame and a separate background on paper. Imagine shifting only the frame and write how the same background would look different.
experiment.zh: 画前景框与独立背景。只想象移框，写同一背景会怎样不同。

description.en: Build an imagined world through folded paths, small character actions or shifting layers. Six creative choices reveal what visitors can do in your original paper scene.
description.zh: 用折叠路径、角色小动作或移动层次，搭想象世界。六次创作选择，看看访客能在原创纸景里做什么。

question.en: Is a layered paper world more complex or advanced than a simple path?
question.zh: 分层纸世界，会比简单路径更高级吗？

answer.en: Layers change what can be seen, paths create a route, and characters give a scene an action. They are different design purposes. A few clear pieces can serve any of them without testing craft skill or spatial intelligence.
answer.zh: 层次改变能看什么，路径创造经过路线，角色给场景动作。三者是不同设计目的。少量清楚纸片也能完成，不考手艺或空间智力。
